messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The Hop Tap?
messages.body:
Hi Tracey,

No worries at all, and thanks for explaining how you normally book.

To be upfront, £200 for a three-hour show is already a big discount. Social clubs and pubs usually pay upwards of £425 for exactly the same setup, so at that price we can't really do a one-off night.

What I can offer is this. We pencil in four or five dates provisionally, and you only confirm the rest after Jake's first night with you. That way you get to see how it goes before committing to anything further.

Jake has built a strong reputation for his shows, and there are dozens of recordings and videos on his website where you can hear his voice and watch him perform, so you can get a good feel for him before the night, though it's always better leaving it a surprise!

If that works for you, just pick four or five nights from the free Saturdays and Sundays in my last email and I'll pencil them in the same day.

Natalie
www.jakeessex.co.uk
